[PATH:empirical] Comparative cross-cultural studies of social network topology in regions with varying levels of technological infrastructure (e.g., high vs. low internet penetration) using survey and network mapping methods — If technology is the primary driver, networks in technologically advanced regions should exhibit distinct structural properties (e.g., more weak ties, higher bridging) compared to less connected regions, controlling for other sociocultural factors.
